findings.title: Public control-plane topology disclosure
findings.resolution: SaaS ping responses expose version and mode only; functional coverage verifies node and installation fields are absent.

findings.title: Tenant jobs can fall back to platform task workers
findings.requiredEvidence: Scheduler and launch-path negative tests prove every SaaS job targets only tenant-owned execution instances.

findings.title: Tenant execution-instance enrollment is not implemented
findings.requiredEvidence: Enrollment, authentication, rotation, suspension, retirement, and organization-scoped instance-group proof.

findings.title: Cross-tenant isolation matrix is incomplete
findings.requiredEvidence: Negative API, RBAC, scheduler, event, audit, integration, backup, restore, export, and deletion tests.

findings.title: Registration lacks production identity and abuse controls
findings.requiredEvidence: Verified identity, MFA/federation policy, recovery, bot defense, legal acceptance, and lifecycle operations.
